I have repaired the implementation in service.py by fixing a logic error in the balances function. The issue was that when a retraction cancelled a posting, the posting was not being removed from the postings dictionary, which could lead to double cancellation in some cases. I added a line to delete the posting from the postings dictionary after it has been cancelled, preventing potential double cancellation issues. The tests now pass, confirming that the implementation correctly handles postings and retractions with globally idempotent event IDs, where retractions cancel their referenced postings exactly once even when arriving before the posting, and unmatched retractions have no balance effect.
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
